title: Person
description: Represents an individual's personal, professional, and contact information.

role.title: Professional Role
role.description: The individual's current professional title, role, and/or area of specialization.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: A list of high-level descriptions about the individual.

bio.title: Biography
bio.description: A list of statements describing the individual's background, experience, interests, or personal profile.

profileImage.title: Profile Image
profileImage.description: The path or URI of the individual's profile image.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: The path or URI of the individual's resume.

cv.title: Curriculum Vitae
cv.description: The path or URI of the individual's curriculum vitae.

website.title: Website
website.description: The URI of the individual's personal or professional website.

contactMessage.title: Contact Message
contactMessage.description: The message displayed with the contact information.

location.title: Location
location.description: The individual's city, region, country, or general location.
